title.zh: Robinhood Engineers Charged With Fraud Over Alleged Crypto Listing Trades
title.en: Robinhood Engineers Charged With Fraud Over Alleged Crypto Listing Trades

current_state.zh: Two former Robinhood engineers were charged with commodities and wire fraud for allegedly using confidential information about upcoming crypto listings to trade perpetual futures on Hyperliquid, each earning over $50,000.
